name: Next Generation STEM Internship (NGSI), Spring 2027
city: Oak Ridge, TN (virtual, for East Tennessee students)
what_you_do: Work part time with ORNL researchers on a STEM project. The spring 2027 round is virtual, for about 16 to 17 weeks.
grades: High school junior or senior (class of 2027 or 2028), or a recent graduate not yet in a degree program
who_can_apply: U.S. citizens or permanent residents, at least 16 by the start date, with a 3.00 GPA or higher. You must be in good standing at a school or approved home school in Anderson, Blount, Campbell, Knox, Loudon, McMinn, Monroe, Morgan, Roane or Sevier County, Tennessee. Proof of health insurance is required.
duration: 16 to 17 weeks, Jan 26 to May 15 or May 22, 2027, part time each week
deadline_text: Spring 2027 applications are open through October 21, 2026.
how_to_apply: Apply on Zintellect by Oct 21, 2026. A full form needs recommendations from a STEM teacher and a principal. Home school students can use a curriculum coordinator. Forms that are missing a recommendation are not read.
notes: Closes very soon. You can miss up to five days without losing stipend. Appointments may be extended depending on funding. Only students from the ten listed Tennessee counties can apply.
